sources.use: Original user-scope, implementation stack, security/isolation, API/outbox and deployment boundary evidence; text extraction was read-only.
B02 is user-scoped API, DB, per-request workspace, depends on B01, acceptance AT-21. B03 separately owns Temporal workflow, outbox, human wait and version pin.
REQ-13 requires isolated per-person work and multiple users; design reference is ownership/workspace isolation; acceptance AT-21.
AT-21 specifies concurrent A/B jobs and A attempting B job/log/image/device reads; server authorization must reject and paths/sessions must remain separated. Status remains not_executed in source.

Designed API contract. Server hostname is placeholder ax.internal.example. Global UserSession is cookie ax_session; BridgeToken and WorkerToken are bearer schemes. User write calls require CSRF and Idempotency-Key.

User identity subject is unique; local pilot identity is mock-only. Projects carry member roles/profile versions. Job owner is derived from auth, never request payload. Queries/downloads require project membership and job ownership/delegated role; service tokens are assignment-scoped. PostgreSQL stores command inbox/outbox, immutable evidence and projections; Temporal is authoritative for process transitions.
Workflow invariants include no concurrent same-workspace writers; this belongs to durable workflow/execution concerns, not a replacement for B02 authorization.
Defines aggregate job-state vocabulary. Included as adjacent state contract; implementation of transitions is separate B03 scope.
Versioned project profile example reviewed for real authentication/configuration references; no real SSO configuration or secret values are present.
Agent workspace rule: one writer per workspace.
Bridge uses outbound HTTPS long poll and authenticated heartbeat; neighboring scoped service-auth contract.
Lists local original source S01 and cited Temporal/FastAPI references. It does not declare an internal SSO provider or approved production hostname.
Design package metadata; the design package is a contract, not an existing service implementation.

Current AX API binds to 127.0.0.1, allows only localhost host values, and permits GET-only /api/dashboard and /api/agents/:id/activity routes. It is a local read-only transcript viewer, not the designed authenticated IFPMIC API.

b02_contract.backlog: B02 depends on B01 and delivers user-scoped API, database, and per-request workspaces; AT-21 is its listed acceptance. Preserve the full scope rather than substituting mock auth or SQLite.
identity_and_authority: User entity fields are user_id, identity_subject, display_name; SSO subject must be unique. Local pilot identity is limited to mock mode.
CreateJob accepts project_id, title, request_text, change_type, base_ref, input_artifact_ids, profile_version, release_mode. It has no owner_id input.
Job response includes owner_id, project_id is part of stored Job entity, and owner must come from authenticated identity rather than request body.

Every query and download checks project membership and job ownership/delegated role. Internal worker and bridge tokens are scoped to assignments. Admin operational visibility does not imply ability to approve on behalf of a user; separate project authority is required.
AT-21 requires negative cross-user reads for job, log, image/artifact, and device data, including direct URLs, plus separation of filesystem paths and sessions.
session_and_csrf_contract: OpenAPI global security is UserSession cookie ax_session for ordinary API routes.

Every user write requires authentication, X-CSRF-Token and Idempotency-Key per DOCX paragraph 356; individual OpenAPI write parameters mark these headers required except artifact service-token alternatives.
Artifact endpoints allow UserSession, BridgeToken or WorkerToken; their CSRF header is required for UserSession and ignored for scoped bearer authentication.

Bridge enrollment and refresh use explicit token exchange routes; heartbeat and assigned command operations use scoped BridgeToken; runtime events use WorkerToken. These are neighboring service identities, not human-session substitutes.
storage_and_workspace: B02 requires persistent DB and per-request workspace. The original stack specifies FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and separate Temporal persistence; Temporal is B03 process authority, PostgreSQL stores command inbox/outbox, immutable evidence and projections.
Workspace and build output directories are per job; one write execution per workspace. Worker and publisher service accounts are separate.

API command authorization/schema checks and command plus outbox insert are one transaction; HTTP 202 means accepted, not applied. Same idempotency key with different body and stale revision conflict; dispatcher retry is deduplicated.
Artifact availability follows metadata registration, byte receipt, size/hash verification, then available state. Downloads reauthorize.
original_api_routes: POST /api/v1/bridge-enrollment-tokens; POST /bridge/v1/enroll and /refresh; POST /bridge/v1/heartbeat; GET /bridge/v1/commands; POST /bridge/v1/commands/{command_id}/events; POST /internal/v1/runtime-events
b02_contract.http_statuses: OpenAPI commonly documents 401 auth required, 403 ownership/role mismatch, 409 revision/idempotency conflict, and 422 invalid schema/state; writes generally return 202 command receipt, artifact metadata registration 201, enrollment 201. Error DTO has code/message/trace_id. Exact error-code enum and detailed field constraints are not supplied.
b02_contract.separate_scope: Temporal workflows, durable transitions, human waits and workflow version pin are B03, though B02 must provide the user/API/database/outbox boundary needed to hand commands over atomically.

missing_real_environment_configuration.status: not supplied in reviewed source set; no credential values copied
missing_references: Approved internal identity provider/SSO issuer and protocol/client registration/callback configuration; OpenAPI only defines a session cookie shape and user entity subject.
Approved internal API hostname/TLS reverse-proxy deployment setting; OpenAPI server remains https://ax.internal.example placeholder.

Provisioned PostgreSQL service/database/migration/backup configuration and separate Temporal persistence/service configuration; architecture names these dependencies but supplies no deployment references.
Real project membership/role assignments and delegated approval policy source; model only names member_roles and delegated role checks.
Production workspace/artifact storage roots, quotas and cleanup/retention policy; design states per-job isolation but no actual paths/configuration.
missing_real_environment_configuration.not_asserted: No claim that credentials or these services do not exist outside this repository; only that this source set does not contain their approved references.

implementation_detail_gaps_and_ambiguiti: The design explicitly labels OpenAPI as a new design contract, not an existing endpoint. AX server/index.mjs currently exposes only local GET read APIs and rejects non-GET API requests with 405.

The OpenAPI specifies session cookie name and CSRF header presence, but not SSO login/callback/logout/session renewal, cookie SameSite/Secure/HttpOnly properties, CSRF issuance/validation algorithm, or session lifetime/revocation.
Project role names, role-grant lifecycle, delegated-role matrix, and authorization precedence for a user who is a project member but not job owner are not enumerated.

CreateJob requires project_id; the OpenAPI Job response exposes owner_id but omits project_id even though the data-model jobs entity includes project_id. Owner assignment is auth-derived; exact database constraints, membership resolution, and project-not-found versus forbidden behavior need implementation-level definition.
OpenAPI provides common status categories and a generic Error DTO, but no stable code enum, trace-id policy, or route-specific validation issue format.

Database entity list and transaction invariants are conceptual field strings rather than DDL/migrations; workspace provisioning/cleanup failure semantics and durable command handoff are not fully specified in B02.
b01_interoperability_note: B01 currently provides a Node library for profile validation/snapshot, while the original backend stack is Python/FastAPI. The reviewed source set does not define a language-neutral B01 boundary or integration mechanism. Record this as an integration question for the owning architecture; this collection does not decide whether to bind subprocess, port a contract, or change stack.
privacy: Source extraction and review omitted all credential values. No service was started, network accessed, or source file modified.
